evidence: Lesson 1 uses a plausible language-choice exchange; Lesson 3 is a first meeting with Daniel, not a drill script.
Targets appear as Do you speak...?, What languages do you speak?, I speak..., and a little English across new contexts.
Activities ask the learner to hear and produce speak without adding a vowel before /sp/; no phonetic terminology is required to succeed.
The initial /sp/ cluster is taught explicitly to prevent a common Persian-speaker prothetic vowel before speak.
Lesson 4 uses a new student card for Leila/Turkey/London/Turkish-English and requires recombination rather than copying Arman’s lines.
